coder_notes: Basket first-in-human trial; glioblastoma named only in the eligibility text (Part 1 and primary CNS tumour measurable-disease criterion), Part 4a is the CNS tumour expansion (IDH-mutant tumours also eligible). ABBV-706 is coded experimental_monotherapy because the GBM-relevant parts (1 and 4a) are monotherapy; in Part 3a it is combined with investigational budigalimab. Trial-level regimen coded monotherapy for the GBM-relevant parts; the trial overall also has combination parts. SEZ6 target of the ADC is inferred from the Part 2 exclusion 'SEZ6-targeted antibody drug conjugate' and the 'potential SEZ6 expression' wording. PK is serum/plasma only.
